To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have presented a new statistical method for analyzing the on-chip power supply network considering spatially correlated sub-threshold leakage current variations.

the Hermite PC method with orthogonal decomposition is more efficient and accurate than the Monte Carlo and Taylor expansion methods for statistical analysis of power grid networks, and that the spatial correlation should be taken into account when considering leakage current variations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the statistical analysis of power grids with stochastic variations.
the statistical analysis of on-chip interconnect networks considering the impact of stochastic sub-thresh- old leakage currents and spatial correlation.
the statistical analysis of power grid networks considering the spatially correlated sub-threshold leakage current variations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method provides a more efficient and accurate way to analyze the power grid voltage drop variations considering lognormal leakage current variations with correlation.
the proposed stochastic method can be used as an efficient statistical analysis tool in power grid network design.

the new stochastic analysis method is accurate, fast and efficient for analyzing the power grid voltage variation considering log-normal sub-threshold leakage current variations with the spatial correlation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, we propose an accurate, efficient and general stochastic method for analyzing power grid networks considering random variations, and the proposed method is applicable to any random process, not just Gaussian process.
the Hermite PC based stochastic analysis method is very efficient for analyzing the power grid voltage variation considering leakage current variations with the spatial correlation.
the Hermite polynomial based method is very efficient in the statistical analysis of power grids.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the spatial correlation of random variables should not be overlooked in the stochastic analysis of power grid networks, and the Hermite PC based analysis is an efficient and accurate method for analyzing random power grid networks.
the spatial correlation of random variables should be taken into account in statistical analysis of on-chip interconnects and power grid networks.
the stochastic analysis of power grid networks should be done with consideration of the spatial correlation between the random variables.
